# ha-taggle

> Open-source, receive-only Taggle water-meter radio decoder for Home Assistant in Australia, using RTL-SDR and MQTT. The supported 922 MHz receive path is DSSS/BPSK. Only one transmitter in Gladstone, Queensland, is field-confirmed; other models and areas are unverified.

Receiver and card version: 0.3.1. Reference checked: 2026-11-03.
Clear messages provide pulse counters, not the dial reading; manual calibration supplies litres and offset. Encrypted bodies are not decrypted. HACS installs the dashboard card; the receiver is a separate add-on, Docker container or Python CLI. The qualified first-public-decoder finding is documented in the wiki research, not a claim of proven priority.

## Project

- [Repository and installation](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle): Canonical source, README and releases.
- [Website](https://ha-taggle.dancloud.au): Project introduction.
- [Factual reference](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/blob/main/docs/llms-full.md): Quoteable summary, common questions, evidence and limitations.
- [Software citation](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Software metadata and MIT licence.

## Protocol and evidence

- [Protocol specification](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md): Physical layer, clear/encrypted frame layouts and counter arithmetic.
- [Tested hardware](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/wiki/Tested-Hardware): Exactly one field-confirmed transmitter; generated tests are separate evidence.
- [Research and prior art](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/wiki/Research-and-Prior-Art): Dated search, cloud MQTT distinction, DSSS and MyWater sources.
- [Coverage](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/wiki/Is-My-Area-Covered): Council deployments are not compatibility guarantees.

## Setup

- [Wiki home](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/wiki): Guides and references.
- [Calibration](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/wiki/Calibration): Two aligned dial readings, litres per pulse and offset.
- [Add-on documentation](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/blob/main/addon/DOCS.md): Home Assistant OS receiver setup.
- [Docker installation](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/wiki/Installing-with-Docker): Standalone receiver setup.
- [Dashboard card](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/wiki/Dashboard-Card): HACS custom repository installation.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/Spicynostalgia/ha-taggle/wiki/Privacy-and-Legal): Own-meter usage and private data handling.
